subject: Fiscal Year 2023 City Budget
overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met with city administration officials to review the proposed fiscal year 2023 budget and discuss a projected budget deficit. Councilors expressed frustration regarding delayed financial updates, federal ARPA funding constraints, and local economic development priorities.

items.title: Mayor's Fiscal Year 2023 Budget Overview
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn presented an overview of the fiscal year 2023 budget, highlighting an $8 million deficit driven by federal ARPA revenue replacement limits and proposing the use of $3.5 million from free cash.

items.title: Finance Director's Revenue and Expense Report
items.summary: Finance Director Bob Dickinson detailed projected revenues, fixed cost increases, level-funding measures for city departments, and long-term risks associated with relying on free cash to cover operating deficits.

items.title: Council Discussion on Financial Planning and Priorities
items.summary: Council members voiced frustration regarding late financial reporting from the administration, slow commercial tax growth, unfunded council budget priorities, and potential school department layoffs.

items.title: ARPA Revenue Loss Rules and Library Donation Impact
items.summary: Consultant Sean McGoldrick explained federal ARPA revenue loss calculation rules and confirmed that a $3.4 million library donation counted as revenue, thereby reducing the city's eligible ARPA revenue replacement capacity.
